author: chidoriyourface
body:
Hello there!
back in September 2013, my account (darwido) got comprimised and used by other users for hacking. My account got banned from 8 other servers for excessive hacking which I myself did not do. I now, changed my account details (Password) and I would be really happy to get another chance. It've been 3 years now and I really want to play on this unique server again.
Have a wonderfull day.

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Since it has been an appropriate amount of time since the ban, you are allowed back onto the server.

*It has been some time since 2013, so I highly suggest reviewing the rules once more and getting up to date with things of that nature.

Have a great day!

-Demur
